* Added back math to new number inputs
- Even faster performance
- Removed unused components
- Small tweaks

* ✨ Enhancements

* Issue #2125 - Added margins to previews

* ✨ Set section start time
- Project section dynamic values
- Section titles left aligned
- Various tweaks

* Added action activate when group starts
- Fixed output preview border not being the same width
- Fixed alt+Enter cut in half broken in beta
- Fixed custom activation issue in beta
- Fixed any activation not working

* Reverted inline-start to left

* Fixed broken CSS inputs in beta

* Show category template

* Favorite scriptures in drawer
- Improved stage item auto size
- Timer to event will reset if repeating
- Fixed unable to edit existing event timer

* Updated output lock action
- Small tweaks

* Enable backdrop filters on stage editor (#2137)

* fix: build errors

* feat: enable backdrop filters on stage editor

1.4.6-beta.1 (#1758)

* ✨ Drawer indicator when search is active after changing tabs
- Artist metadata auto set from web lyrics

- Updated Hungarian language

* ☁️ Weather forecast item
- Fixed effect assets not rendered in production build
- Fixed changing item opacity not working

* fix(text-editor): prevent chord movement corruption in text editor (#1750)

Fixed two bugs in slide matching logic that caused text corruption when moving chords:

1. Slide fingerprinting: Create chord-position-agnostic fingerprint using sorted unique chords instead of position-dependent chord order
2. Content update: Always update slide content when matched, not just when slide count changes

This ensures chord movements like \Ama[G]zing\ → \[G]Amazing\ preserve all content correctly.

* ✨ Select output style from popup
- Select stage layout popup for stage output
- Fixed output text not properly updating when changing style
- Live stream style preset
- New plain lower thirds template
- Unsplash credits no longer shows up on outputs with no background
- Removed mirror item as its main functionality has been gradually added elsewhere
- UI enhancements
- Updated Czech language

* Improve Chord Parser in Quick Lyrics (#1754)

* fix(text-editor): prevent chord movement corruption in text editor

Fixed two bugs in slide matching logic that caused text corruption when moving chords:

1. Slide fingerprinting: Create chord-position-agnostic fingerprint using sorted unique chords instead of position-dependent chord order
2. Content update: Always update slide content when matched, not just when slide count changes

This ensures chord movements like \Ama[G]zing\ → \[G]Amazing\ preserve all content correctly.

* Enhance chord parsing for lyrics with chords above text

Improve the quick lyrics feature to properly parse traditional chord sheets
where chords appear on lines above the corresponding lyrics. This addresses
the common use case where users paste lyrics formatted with chords positioned
above the words they align with.

Changes:
- Enhanced isChordLine() function to detect complex chord patterns including
  slash chords (C/G), extended chords (Fadd9, Gsus), and major/minor variations
- Added preprocessLines() function to handle chord line detection and processing
- Implemented insertChordsIntoLyrics() to accurately place chords at their exact
  column positions from the chord line, preserving visual alignment
- Modified convertText() to preprocess chord lines before section splitting
- Removed duplicate chord processing in createSlide() function
- Fixed empty line handling after section headers ([Verse], [Chorus], etc.)
- Cleaned up console.log statement and improved code formatting

The parser now correctly converts input like:
        C     F    C
Lord, I come, I confess

Into proper inline format:
Lord, I co[C]me, I [F]confe[C]ss

This maintains the exact positioning from the original chord sheet while
